title: HCP1065 Population-Averaged Tractography Atlas — HCP1065
text: HCP1065 population-averaged tractography atlas updated atlas HCP842 version. new atlas relies 1,065 subjects based ICBM 2009a Nonlinear Asymmetric space, whereas HCP842 relied 842 subjects based FSL’s FA map (58 FA images averaged old MNI152). new atlas provides subcomponents cingulum, superior longitudinal fasciculus, corticopontine tract, corticostriatal tract, corticothalamic tract (renamed thalamic radiation).
